recommendation: Keep this empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-30319 unless the Vocabulary/Terminology Infrastructure group later changes the broader deprecated-identifier policy.
issue_request: FHIR-30319 was a Published Vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to add usage-note text to the comment on NamingSystem.uniqueId.period. The approved text says identifier deprecation is not represented by a separate element, that the validity period end date is updated when an identifier is deemed deprecated, and that the identifier should no longer be used once the period end date is reached.
initial_application: The issue was applied by ab0ada522243d1ecd280228fc660c8628115a383 on 2022-08-22, whose commit message explicitly says "FHIR-30319 Added usage note for NamingSystem.uniqueId.period" and whose patch appended the approved deprecation note to source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml. The current source still contains that note in the NamingSystem.uniqueId.period comment.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml is in current build scope. Confluence Vocab minutes from January 2021 and August 2022 record the same policy direction: deprecated identifiers are represented with uniqueId.period rather than a separate deprecated element, and the tracker call moved FHIR-30319 to resolved-change-required with the deprecation task-force context. Later NamingSystem changes, including the 2025 jurisdiction undeprecation cleanup, did not alter or contradict the uniqueId.period deprecation note. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active current source already carries the approved FHIR-30319 comment on NamingSystem.uniqueId.period, and no later evidence indicates a different current-spec rule.

related_jiras.note: Related NamingSystem.uniqueId.period constraint work shows the same period element is used for temporal identifier semantics, but it is a separate already-published issue.
Rejected adding a general Deprecated PublicationStatus code, supporting the FHIR-30319 approach of not adding a separate deprecated state for NamingSystem identifiers.
Later terminology-resource identifier metadata work was noted in policy context but does not change the FHIR-30319 uniqueId.period usage note.
